metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Kettleby's call, Two Gentlemen in the afternoon, and the one sentence after it.

yesterday: My lord comes unlooked-for on Thursday the second of October. Kettleby wrote the day down.
The Lord Treasurer cannot stir hand nor foot. Every paper that wants his hand is waiting on his foot.
Heminges's sentence is the last one. You play it as licensed.
Tomorrow is a writing day at the lodging. The Friar is still on the tables, with the line the carrier gave.
